acceptance_criterion: The organiser can see any outstanding clarification message on their own event
test_name: lets the owning organiser see the outstanding clarification

acceptance_criterion: The organiser can reply with a message, amend the request fields, or both
test_name: accepts an amendment with no message

acceptance_criterion: A response with neither a message nor an amendment is refused and no timestamp is recorded
test_name: refuses a response with neither a message nor an amendment, recording no timestamp

acceptance_criterion: On response the event status returns to Under Review and the response timestamp is recorded
test_name: returns the event to Under Review and records the response time

acceptance_criterion: The values as originally submitted are retained in the event history alongside the amended values
test_name: retains the value as originally submitted alongside the amended value

acceptance_criterion: The coordinator who requested the clarification is notified that the organiser has responded
test_name: notifies the coordinator who asked for the clarification

acceptance_criterion: An organiser who does not own the event cannot view or answer the clarification
test_name: gives an organiser who does not own the event no clarification content

acceptance_criterion: The organiser can amend the request fields, including its venue requirements, with the originals retained in the history
test_name: lets the organiser amend the venue requirements, keeping the original in the history
